import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyExterior

/-!
# Extensionality from degree-one cup products

When the exterior cup comparison is surjective, a linear map out of integral
cohomology is determined by its values on iterated degree-one cup products.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- Linear maps from cohomology agree when they agree on iterated degree-one
cups, provided the exterior cup comparison is surjective. -/
theorem singularCohomologyLinearMap_ext_of_exteriorPower_surjective
    (X : TopCat) (n : ℕ)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (singularCohomologyExteriorPower X n))
    {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ M]
    {f g : IntegralSingularCohomology X n →ₗ[ℤ] M}
    (hfg : ∀ c : Fin n → IntegralSingularCohomology X 1,
      f (singularCohomologyIteratedCup X n c) =
        g (singularCohomologyIteratedCup X n c)) :
    f = g := by
  have he : f.comp (singularCohomologyExteriorPower X n) =
      g.comp (singularCohomologyExteriorPower X n) := by
    apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    ext c
    change f (singularCohomologyExteriorPower X n (exteriorPower.ιMulti ℤ n c)) =
      g (singularCohomologyExteriorPower X n (exteriorPower.ιMulti ℤ n c))
    simpa only [singularCohomologyExteriorPower_ιMulti] using hfg c
  ext x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hsurj x
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun he y

end Mumford.Analytic
